newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 8.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Education reform committee has concluded five reform directions to be reported to Premier Lien Chan on November 25.
Prosecutors arrest council speaker of central Tachia town on for allegedly operating a casino.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Prosecutors bust gangster ring, arresting Tachia town council speaker.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan will accelerate petrochemical zone development in and expand airline link with South Africa to secure bilateral relations.
October trade surplus down 62.2 percent from a year earlier.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Parliament urges tax exemption for workers not protected by the Labour Standard Law.
Both the index and daily turnover of over-the-counter securities market hit new highs.
